exposure: Perception of support during childbirth (measured by SCIB scale)
Perception of control during childbirth (measured by SCIB scale)
outcome: Factor structure of the SCIB scale
cohort: The study participants included 414 post-partum women recruited 24/48 hours after giving birth.
finding: Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) of the Italian Support and Control in Birth (SCIB) scale yielded a six-factor structure.
